body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 6e3e4397b03fd47db6af060c3e03a61243903ee6 -->
Needs changes before merge. This is a safety-tier review.

The closing rings fix the measured wall scallops. The new tests check wall coverage and feed crossings. The clearance assertion now uses the correct distance to the block.

**Local build and tests**

I tested the trial merge with upstream/main at `36348cda60cdd8ff66810bbb87b12f4f0f80e6b9` in `.claude/worktrees/review-3130`. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 686 steps, zero failures. The test results contain 5,317 passes and 62 ignored tests.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `pocket_wall_finish`: 5 passed. `setup_align`: 10 passed. Motion `corner_blend`: 14 passed. App `corner_blend`: 5 passed.
- All temporary mutation changes were restored. The final source diff is empty against the local trial merge.

**Extra suites run**

I searched the sources for readers of the changed golden and sample directories. The expanded gate ran these suites by name:

| Crate | Suite | Result |
|---|---|---|
| app | `golden_cl` | 33 passed |
| app | `conformance` | 7 passed |
| app | `solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |
| app | `first_part_programs` | 2 passed |
| app | `example_catalog` | 33 passed, 2 ignored |
| cl | `headless_bin` | 3 passed |
| post | `post_engine` | 33 passed |
| post | `explain_tormach` | 3 passed |
| post | `heidenhain_block_form` | 5 passed |

The gate also passed all 47 selected post test steps and all 618 app test steps. These include the other readers of the shared golden directory. No STEP fixture or importer changes occur in this PR. The importer add-on does not apply.

**Mutation checks**

1. Restore the old rows-only guard: four wall tests fail. The scallops measure 0.755 mm, or 0.919 mm with blends. Restore the fix: all five tests pass.
2. Remove the Zigzag crossing hold: `blended_zigzag_turns_do_not_cross_the_closing_rings` fails with 12 crossing pairs. Restore the fix: the test passes.

**Golden review**

I checked the changed CL paths and the sample-program changes. I also compared every XYZ, feed and motion-mode line in all 14 changed NC goldens against the CL path. Each agrees at the dialect's output precision. Setup, tool, spindle, coolant and shutdown blocks stay unchanged. Only `2D Pocket1` changes in each sample program. The new outer and island rings close at each cut level.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs:321` — Run the reached heavy lanes on the final head and record their results in the PR body. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, **Heavy lanes at review**, makes this a readiness requirement. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects both motion and app. The PR body states that the heavy lanes were not run. This review did not run them. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. Keep the PR in draft until the reached tests pass.

No code defect was found in the reviewed change. There is no UI change, so before/after UI screenshots do not apply. The heavy-lane evidence is the only blocker. The PR remains a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Gate reading on head 6e3e4397b (found from the stacked PR #3167). These motion tests fail on this head, debug build:

- `center_cut_law::a_tool_that_is_not_centre_cutting_never_plunges_into_a_pocket_between_passes`: `crossed_pairs` gives 6 `Crossing` pairs (moves 291/319, 291/607, 296/320, 296/608, 581/609, 586/610).
- `level_links::keep_down_pass_links_stay_at_depth_where_proved_and_say_where_not`: the assert at line 285 fails ("keep-down found nothing to keep").
- `machining2d::zigzag_fills_a_square_with_one_plunge_per_level`
- `machining2d::zigzag_hops_over_islands_and_leaves_them_standing`

All four call the plain `pocket()`. #3167 does not change that path. The four tests also fail with the code of #3167 put back to this head.
